description: A square grid of 6 rows x 6 columns of large solid BLACK dots (36 dots, counted). Over it, thin RED L-shaped lines divide the dots into 6 nested groups growing from the bottom-left corner. Each red line runs horizontally above a row, from the left side of the grid to just right of a column, then turns and runs straight down to the bottom of the grid. The outermost red line goes along the top edge and the right edge of the whole grid; the other five are nested inside it, each one row lower and one column further left, the innermost enclosing only the bottom-left dot. Groups from the bottom-left corner outwards: group 1 = the single bottom-left dot (1 dot); group 2 = row 5 columns 1-2 plus row 6 column 2 (3 dots); group 3 = 5 dots; group 4 = 7 dots; group 5 = 9 dots; group 6 = the whole top row plus the whole right-hand column (6 + 5 = 11 dots). Group sizes in order: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9, 11 (sum 36). No numbers are printed on the picture; the sum is written in the text below ('1 + 3 + 5 + 7 + 9 + 11 = 36', result in red).
